manifest.original_question: 胰臟癌(pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC)目前有哪些已知的治療標的?
manifest.research_objective: Identify known therapeutic targets for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) by retrieving disease-associated targets from Open Targets, enriching with known drug evidence and tractability data, and organizing these as distinguishable evidence dimensions without inferring therapeutic priority or efficacy.

plan_steps.description: 解析胰臟癌(PDAC)提及為標準疾病實體
從 Open Targets 擷取與 PDAC 相關聯的標的候選
為發現的標的候選擷取已知標的-藥物關係與證據
為發現的標的候選擷取可成藥性與小分子 tractability 證據
整理疾病關聯、標的-藥物證據與 tractability 為可重疊的描述性證據維度

evidence_requirements: Disease-target association scores from Open Targets for PDAC
Known drug-target relationships with mechanism/action type from ChEMBL and Open Targets
Tractability assessments (small molecule, antibody, etc.) from Open Targets
Preservation of missing data as unknown rather than negative
completion_criteria: Disease mention resolved to at least one candidate disease entity
Target candidates retrieved with association scores
Drug evidence and tractability evidence retrieved for discovered targets
Evidence stratified into distinguishable overlapping dimensions (association, drug, tractability)
No therapeutic priority or efficacy inference made in this plan
